## Atomie (CR 1)

**XP** **400**  
CN Tiny fey  
**Init** +7; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +7  


**Defense**


**AC** 15, touch 15, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +2 size)  
**hp** 18 (3d6)  
**Fort** +1; **Ref** +6; **Will** +4  
**DR** 5/cold iron; **SR** 12  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft., fly 60 ft. (good)  
**Melee** short sword +6 (1d3-3)  
**Ranged** light crossbow +6 (1d4)  
**Space** 2-1/2 ft.; **Reach** 0 ft.  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 3rd)


3/day—blink, entangle (DC 13), invisibility (self only), pass without trace, speak with animals  


**Statistics**


**Str** 5, **Dex** 17, **Con** 11, **Int** 12, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 14  
**Base Atk** +1; **CMB** +2; **CMD** 9

**Skills** Acrobatics +9, Bluff +8, Craft (any) +7, Escape Artist +9, Fly +11, Knowledge (nature) +7, Perception +7, Perform (dance) +8, Stealth +11 (+15 in forests); **Racial Modifiers** +4 Stealth in forests  
**Languages** Common, Sylvan  



**Ecology**
